=

Finds the AMD core microbiome from the recovery CSV made by `build_manysearch_csvs.Rmd`. Run that first.

### Terms
ih = intersect hashes.

`gate_ih_min`: Reference genomes that meet the `gate_ih_min` threshold in at least `gate_min_srr` metagenomes are eligible for recovery in every metagenome.

`recov_ih_min`: If a reference genome is eligible for recovery, its hits in other metagenomes are kept as long as they meet this threshold.

The build CSV was made at gate 3, recovery 1 ("any 3 saves all 1"), which is the most inclusive setting. Any stricter gate or recovery threshold used here is a subset of it, so one CSV serves every cutoff.

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Parameters

```{r params}
# thresholds the build CSV was made with (must match the file name)
build_gate_ih_min  <- 3
build_recov_ih_min <- 1

# analysis thresholds (must be >= the build values)
gate_ih_min  <- 20    # main gate: ih needed in one metagenome (20 or 50)
gate_min_srr <- 3     # metagenomes that must meet the gate (1 = "ANY one", raise to be stricter)
recov_ih_min <- 1     # ih needed to keep a hit from a genome eligible for recovery (try 3 if 1-2 ih hits look like noise)
min_freq     <- 0.90  # prevalence cutoff for "core"

stopifnot(gate_ih_min >= build_gate_ih_min, recov_ih_min >= build_recov_ih_min)

in_dir  <- "../manysearch"
in_file <- file.path(in_dir, sprintf("manysearch_gate%d_recov%d.csv",
                                     build_gate_ih_min, build_recov_ih_min))

# denominator = all metagenomes, even ones with no hits
n_srr <- length(list.files(in_dir, pattern = "^SRR.*\\.csv$"))
```

## 1. Load the recovery CSV

```{r load}
if (!file.exists(in_file)) stop('"', in_file, '" not found. Run build_manysearch_csvs.Rmd first.')

recovered <- read_csv(in_file,
                      col_types = cols(query_name = "c", match_name = "c",
                                       intersect_hashes = "d", species = "c"))

species_key <- distinct(recovered, query_name, species)

cat(format(nrow(recovered), big.mark = ","), "rows loaded from", normalizePath(in_file), "\n")
cat(nrow(species_key), "genomes,", n_distinct(recovered$match_name), "of", n_srr, "metagenomes with hits\n")
```

## 2. Prevalence functions

`eligible_at(h)` returns the genomes that meet `h` ih in at least `gate_min_srr` metagenomes, which are the genomes eligible for recovery at that gate. In `prev_at()`, the recovered method keeps their hits down to `recov_ih_min`, while strict-only requires `h` everywhere.

```{r prevalence-fns}
eligible_at <- function(h) {
  recovered %>%
    filter(intersect_hashes >= h) %>%
    distinct(query_name, match_name) %>%
    count(query_name) %>%
    filter(n >= gate_min_srr) %>%
    pull(query_name)
}

prev_at <- function(h, recover = TRUE) {
  d <- if (recover) {
    recovered %>% filter(query_name %in% eligible_at(h), intersect_hashes >= recov_ih_min)
  } else {
    recovered %>% filter(intersect_hashes >= h)
  }
  d %>%
    distinct(species, match_name) %>%
    count(species, name = "n_present") %>%
    mutate(freq = n_present / n_srr,
           gate_ih = h,
           method = if (recover) "recovered" else "strict only") %>%
    arrange(desc(freq))
}
```

## 3. Core at the main gate

```{r core}
by_species <- prev_at(gate_ih_min, recover = TRUE)
core <- by_species %>% filter(freq >= min_freq)

nrow(core)

by_species %>%
  summarize(at_80 = sum(freq >= 0.80),
            at_90 = sum(freq >= 0.90),
            at_95 = sum(freq >= 0.95))
```

Which species gained the most prevalence from recovery?

```{r recovery-gain}
strict <- prev_at(gate_ih_min, recover = FALSE)

by_species %>%
  select(species, freq_recovered = freq) %>%
  left_join(strict %>% select(species, freq_strict = freq), by = "species") %>%
  mutate(freq_strict = replace_na(freq_strict, 0),
         gain = freq_recovered - freq_strict) %>%
  arrange(desc(gain)) %>%
  head(15)
```

## 4. Sensitivity, recovered vs strict-only

```{r core-sensitivity}
gate_cuts <- c(3, 10, 20, 50)
freq_cuts <- c(0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95, 0.999)

stopifnot(all(gate_cuts >= build_gate_ih_min))

prev_grid <- expand_grid(h = gate_cuts, recover = c(TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
  pmap(\(h, recover) prev_at(h, recover)) %>%
  list_rbind()

core_counts <- prev_grid %>%
  crossing(min_freq = freq_cuts) %>%
  summarize(n_core = sum(freq >= min_freq), .by = c(method, gate_ih, min_freq))

core_counts %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(min_freq), y = n_core, fill = method)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_core), position = position_dodge(0.8),
            angle = 90, hjust = -0.2, size = 3, color = "#5C3317") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("recovered" = "#A0522D", "strict only" = "#D2B48C")) +
  facet_wrap(~ gate_ih, nrow = 1,
             labeller = labeller(gate_ih = \(x) paste0("gate ≥ ", x, " ih"))) +
  labs(x = "Minimum prevalence (fraction of metagenomes)",
       y = "Number of core species", fill = NULL,
       title = "AMD core size, recovered vs strict-only") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#5C3317"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```

## 5. Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
# denominator: freq should never exceed 1
n_srr
n_distinct(recovered$match_name)
range(prev_grid$freq)

# species parsing: NAs and the shape of the names
sum(is.na(species_key$species))
head(species_key$query_name, 5)
species_key %>% count(species, sort = TRUE, name = "n_genomes") %>% head(10)

# how much of the recovered data is low-ih hits
recovered %>% count(ih_bin = cut(intersect_hashes, c(0, 2, 9, 19, 49, Inf)))

# are 1-2 ih hits everywhere? (if most genomes hit most metagenomes this way, it's noise)
recovered %>%
  filter(intersect_hashes < 3) %>%
  distinct(query_name, match_name) %>%
  count(query_name) %>%
  summarize(median_srrs = median(n),
            frac_genomes_in_90pct = mean(n >= 0.9 * n_srr))
```

# genus

```{r}
recovered <- recovered %>%
  mutate(genus = word(str_trim(query_name), 2))

species_key <- distinct(recovered, query_name, species, genus)
```


```{r}
prev_at <- function(h, recover = TRUE, level = "species") {
  d <- if (recover) {
    recovered %>% filter(query_name %in% eligible_at(h), intersect_hashes >= recov_ih_min)
  } else {
    recovered %>% filter(intersect_hashes >= h)
  }
  d %>%
    distinct(taxon = .data[[level]], match_name) %>%
    count(taxon, name = "n_present") %>%
    mutate(freq = n_present / n_srr,
           gate_ih = h,
           level = level,
           method = if (recover) "recovered" else "strict only") %>%
    arrange(desc(freq))
}

by_genus     <- prev_at(gate_ih_min, recover = TRUE,  level = "genus")
strict_genus <- prev_at(gate_ih_min, recover = FALSE, level = "genus")

by_genus %>%
  select(taxon, freq_recovered = freq) %>%
  left_join(strict_genus %>% select(taxon, freq_strict = freq), by = "taxon") %>%
  mutate(freq_strict = replace_na(freq_strict, 0),
         gain = freq_recovered - freq_strict) %>%
  arrange(desc(gain)) %>%
  head(15)


```






```{r}
core_strict_20 <- read_csv("intermediate_files/core_prevalence/prevalence_grid.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(level == "species", method == "strict only", gate_ih == 20, freq >= 0.90) %>%
  select(taxon, n_present, freq) %>%
  arrange(desc(freq)) |> 
  select(taxon)

write_csv(core_strict_20, "intermediate_files/core_prevalence/core_species_strict_gate20_freq90.csv")
```
